name: Modern SEO - M1L1 Modern SEO Welcome
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO - Module 1 Foundation and Diagnosis](lib:brain-modern-seo-module-1-foundation-and-diagnosis) | [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
A 2:11 welcome. The course promises the instructor's agency processes as step-by-step systems, not theory. Module 1 builds two skills: diagnosing why a local business is not ranking, and a repeatable process to fix it.

# Key concepts
- **Process over theory.** Daily agency processes plus over-the-shoulder demos of a method "we use for every client."
- **Diagnose before you fix.** The diagnostic process is called "the foundation of everything we do."
- **Phased roadmap.** From a three-step foundation up to the "Core 30 method" and geographic expansion, each phase built on the last.
- **The basics are often enough.** The three-step method (GBP audit, landing page optimization, super citations) is claimed to work for 70 to 80% of local businesses in markets under 500,000 people.
- The course also mentions client acquisition strategies for agencies.

# Checklist
- Diagnose why the business is not ranking before changing anything.
- Confirm the three-step foundation is done before advanced work like Core 30.
- Note market size (under or over 500,000 people) to judge whether three steps alone are likely enough.

# Notable quotes
- "I'm not going to go over theory or generic advice."
- "This diagnostic process is the foundation of everything we do."

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Treat the M1L2 diagnosis as the first step of any review for [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub), [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub) and [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Use the three steps ([Google Business Profile](lib:brain-google-business-profile), landing page, citations) as a frame to spot each client's weakest area. Any changes are Kim's to apply; Claude stays read-only on client sites.

# Caveats and open questions
- The lesson preview numbering does not match the files: the real Lesson 3 (How Google and AI Actually Work) is not mentioned, and the roadmap and three-step lessons are actually 4 and 5.
- "Millions in revenue" and the 70 to 80% figure are unverified instructor claims.
- Says four modules; all four are now in the vault (Module 4 is [Modern SEO - Module 4 Client Acquisition and Pricing](lib:brain-modern-seo-module-4-client-acquisition-and-pricing)).
